title: Fair Market Baseline — Independent Freelance Service Agreement

fairClauses.title: Payment Terms & Late Payment Interest
fairClauses.text: Invoices shall be payable within 15 to 30 days of submission. Overdue payments shall accrue interest at 1.5% per month.

fairClauses.title: IP Transfer Upon Full Payment
fairClauses.text: Intellectual Property created under this agreement shall transfer to the Client upon full payment of all invoice fees.

fairClauses.title: Mutual Cap on Liability
fairClauses.text: Each party's maximum aggregate liability shall be capped at the total fees paid or payable under the applicable Statement of Work.

fairClauses.title: Mutual Indemnification
fairClauses.text: Each party agrees to indemnify the other against third-party claims arising from gross negligence, willful misconduct, or IP infringement.
